purpose: Validation-selected comparison of uniform and size-weighted normalized-displacement AE reconstruction for stiffness_low only.
model: Fresh 2D message_passing_reference16 normalized-displacement AE; no propagator.

loss.coordinates: same standardized normalized-displacement target coordinates used by AE reconstruction
loss.uniform: weight 1 for every source/frame row t=1..499
loss.inverse_energy_cap100: E_t is training-only mean squared reference-displacement target magnitude after division by target_std (without target_mean subtraction), over trajectories, nodes and coordinates; epsilon=median(E_t:t=1..499)/100; raw=1/max(E_t,epsilon); normalize weights to mean 1 over t=1..499.

selection: Each arm restores its minimum corresponding validation coordinate objective. Both frozen arms record the common unweighted validation MSE and the common fixed inverse-energy validation MSE; only these commensurate validation diagnostics compare arms. Framewise/early coordinate reconstruction and p-ratio are post-fit diagnostics only. Heldout IDs 40..119 are not loaded by fitting or selection.
